description: Send to a phone number: may create a temporary contact, then send text or files. Supports parse_mode: classic markdown/html/auto or rich (Rich Message; dialect auto-detected). parse_mode=rich cannot be combined with files. schedule_date (ISO 8601, future) queues the message instead of delivering now; save_as_draft=true saves the text as the draft in that chat instead of sending. Success: send result plus contact_was_new / contact_removed when applicable.  Full documentation: https://github.com/leshchenko1979/fast-mcp-telegram/blob/main/docs/Tools-Reference.md

files.description: List of attachment URLs, local paths, or data URIs (one or more strings). data: URIs (data:<mime>;base64,<payload>) work in all server modes; local paths work in stdio mode only.

first_name.description: First name when creating a temporary contact.

last_name.description: Last name when creating a temporary contact.

message.description: Message text. When sending files, used as caption.

parse_mode.description: 'markdown'/'html'/'auto': classic entity formatting (auto detects). 'rich': Telegram Rich Message document; dialect auto-detected (known HTML tags outside code → rich HTML, else rich markdown). Default is 'auto'. parse_mode='rich' cannot be combined with files.

phone_number.description: E.164 phone number with country code, e.g. +1234567890 (must be on Telegram).

remove_if_new.description: If true, delete the contact after send when it was created only for this send.

reply_to_msg_id.description: Reply to this message id in the target chat after resolve.

save_as_draft.description: If true, save the text as the chat's draft instead of sending or editing (an empty text clears the existing draft). User sessions only — bot accounts cannot call messages.saveDraft. Cannot be combined with schedule_date, files, or parse_mode='rich'.

schedule_date.description: ISO 8601 instant at which Telegram should deliver the message, e.g. '2026-10-20T09:00:00Z' or '2026-10-20T12:00:00+03:00'. Must be in the future. On send: queues the message instead of delivering now. On edit: reschedules an already-queued message.

name: send_message_to_phone
title: Send message to phone
